social.headline: SOCIAL MEDIA
social.sub: A consistent, on-brand presence, managed monthly.
social.subject: A social presence that shows up every day
social.scope: For retail brands, we turn your storefront and catalog into a steady feed of short video, posts, and stories that keep the brand present between purchases.
social.proof: We have run social for consumer and retail brands and moved them from irregular posting to a consistent, on-brand presence that compounds over time.
social.future: As the channel matures we layer in paid amplification and shoppable formats without adding to your team's workload.
hooks: Consistency beats bursts
A fixed monthly output keeps your audience warm, so you are the brand they remember at the moment of purchase.
Short video earns the reach
Six cuts a month give the platforms fresh signals while your feed and stories hold the brand together.
We manage the conversation
Community management on comments and DMs turns passive followers into orders, not just likes.

Technical fixes and on-page work put you on the first page where high-intent buyers actually look.
AI answers are the new front page
AEO and GEO get you cited inside AI-generated answers instead of left out of them.
Speed and experience convert
SRX and Core Web Vitals work turns visits into enquiries instead of bounces.

website.subject: A website that turns visits into orders

You stay in control

erp.subject: Software built around how you work

One source of truth

Automation removes the busywork
Workflow automations and integrations cut the manual steps that slow projects down.

schoolos.headline: SCHOOLOS
schoolos.sub: Run the whole school on one connected platform.
schoolos.subject: Run the whole school on one platform
deliverables: Attendance: daily and period, parent alerts
Fees: invoices, online payments, reminders, receipts
HR and payroll: staff and salaries
schoolos.scope: For schools, SchoolOS runs admissions to reporting on one connected platform, so staff spend less time on admin and more on students.
schoolos.proof: We have built school operations software that replaced separate registers and tools with a single system parents and staff share.
schoolos.future: The Nectar assistant automates routine admin across admissions, attendance, and fees, and the platform grows with each new intake.

Admissions, attendance, fees, and exams share the same records, so nothing is entered twice.
Parents stay informed

Reports write themselves
Management dashboards turn daily activity into decisions without manual collation.
